newsitem.title: UK: UK's Abbey National raises mortgage rates.
newsitem.headline: UK's Abbey National raises mortgage rates.

text.p: Britain's Abbey National Plc said on Thursday it was increasing its standard variable mortgage rates by 25 basis points.
The increases will take effect from Friday for new borrowers and August 1 for existing borrowers.
UK's Abbey National raises mortgage rates
The rate for Abbey National borrowers with mortgages of up to 59,999 pounds ($101,000) will rise to 8.20 percent from 7.95 percent.

The cost of mortgages between 60,000 and 99,999 pounds will increase to 8.15 percent from 7.9 percent while mortgages in excess of 100,000 pounds will have a rate of 8.10 percent, up from 7.85 percent.
The decision comes in the wake of a 1/4 point rise in interest rates to 6.75 percent announced by the Bank of England earlier on Thursday.
Other home loan groups such as the Woolwich, Halifax Plc and Alliance and Leicester said they were reviewing their rates following the central bank's move.($ = 0.593 British Pounds)
